scope: Task-specific qualification; access and checksums do not establish biological confirmation

sources.assay: MOSAIC scRNA-seq; per-cell 10000-library log2 transform then matched-control-relative mean
sources.baseline: matched vehicle means; fixed cell-line identities, not treatment-derived clusters
sources.confounding: shared study; line identity and baseline state associated; no independently randomized cross-study mapping
sources.contexts: eight cell lines; one study/assay; source-cell pooling is not culture replication
sources.download_access: public; six previously verified shards retained
sources.exposure: all pilot single and held pair results previously exposed; new folds are development only
sources.gene_panel: 1024 control-selected Ensembl identifiers; declared query-control adaptation
sources.interventions: 18 exact compound/dose/5-day single identities; 17 genuine pair identities; no efficacy assay supplied
sources.matching: exact doses and endpoint; controls, singles and pairs matched within line

sources.assay: sci-RNA-seq3; sparse raw UMI matrix constructed by documented harmonizer
sources.baseline: line/plate-matched vehicle; baseline uses known cell line, never response-derived cell labels
sources.confounding: three cell lines in one study; cannot attribute cross-study assay differences to biology
sources.download_access: public publisher file; verify MD5 and length before acceptance
sources.exposure: New to local Opal result inventory, already widely used by public methods. All new scores are development.
sources.interventions: 188 drugs at four doses in primary source; bounded new panel uses 24 lexicographically selected shared exact 1000 nM conditions at one endpoint
sources.metadata_limits: Catalog/reagent identifiers and culture mapping removed; chemical name/dose/time retained. Efficacy is not supplied.
sources.pretraining: no external pretrained weights or expression examples
sources.replication: Rep1/rep2 and well/plate labels preserved; original culture and sample mapping removed. Whole line holdouts group both replicate labels. Nominal duplicate-well sensitivity is measured, without independent-culture precision claims.
sources.revision: scPerturb 1.4 corrected release; older 1.3 file not used

sources.aggregation_alternative: Whole-population versus baseline-defined lineage effects require original phenotype and sorting metadata; current exposed label-conditioned results remain restricted.
sources.exposure: Frozen procedure and source-radius tests already exposed and failed; not reopened in this build
sources.reason: Published labels are post-treatment. Conditioning on a treatment-dependent lineage can change the population, and batch copies do not create biological replication.
sources.terms: Local derivatives; public redistribution not cleared

sources.exposure: Widely public benchmark; no local new scores
sources.labels: Post-treatment cell-type labels require conditioning review; donor-genotype grouping can avoid that definition
sources.reason: Eight pooled lupus donors and one IFN-beta intervention cannot assess diverse intervention representations or combinations. Selected convenience file unavailable; no data accepted.

sources.exposure: Existing public benchmark; no local scores
sources.reason: Small processed context benchmark with selected effective perturbations and gene panels; response-dependent selection/preprocessing scope is not qualified for the new raw-count contract. Use corrected raw sci-Plex instead.
Existing discovery records do not qualify exact overlapping reagent, exposure, assay and biological-unit contracts across studies. No incompatible-study pooled benchmark constructed.

accepted_tasks: Norman and Wessels existing single-context pair tasks
sources.exposure: Existing genetic development and held outcomes retained; no old evaluator reopening
